about: Screens the art is reviewed on. Open one with http://localhost:5173/?review=<name>. camera = top-left of the view in level pixels; melody/boy = where they stand (x, and y of their feet). frames = how long the scene runs before the picture is taken (60 = 1 second). Add your own: press F9 while playing (npm run dev) and the details are copied for you. See docs/ART-PIPELINE.md.
